mini_task_spec:
Using the shell `exec` tool, count the number of TypeScript source files in each top-level package under `test-repo/packages/`. A "TypeScript source file" is any file ending in `.ts` that does NOT end in `.spec.ts` or `.d.ts`. Ignore the two `tsconfig*.json` pseudo-entries — only consider the nine real package directories: `common`, `core`, `microservices`, `platform-express`, `platform-fastify`, `platform-socket.io`, `platform-ws`, `testing`, `websockets`.

Run the following command (or equivalent) with `cwd` set to `test-repo/`:

```
for pkg in common core microservices platform-express platform-fastify platform-socket.io platform-ws testing websockets; do count=$(find "packages/$pkg" -name "*.ts" ! -name "*.spec.ts" ! -name "*.d.ts" -type f | wc -l); echo "$pkg: $count"; done
```

Report the result as one line per package in the format `<package-name>: <count>`, sorted alphabetically by package name (which is the natural sort order of the names above). No trailing spaces or extra blank lines.
